1 1 . J u d g e m e n t a n d o r d e r d a t e d 3 0 . 1 1 . 2 0 0 6 r e n d e r e d b y t h e l e a r n e d 5 t h  J u d i c i a l M a g i s t r a t e F i r s t C l a s s , B h u j K c h c h h i n C r i m i n a l C a s e N o . 
1 1 3 7 o f 1 9 9 3 r e c o r d i n g a c q u i t t a l f o r o p p o n e n t s n o . 1 , 2 a n d 3 f o r t h e  offence punishable under Section 7(1)(5) and Section 2(ia)(a)(j) of the R/CR.A/434/2010 JUDGMENT Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 ( For short 'the P.F.A. Act') 
a n d R u l e 5 o f t h e P r e v e n t i o n o f F o o d A d u l t e r a t i o n R u l e s , 1 9 5 5 ( f o r  s h o r t ' t h e P . F . A . R u l e s ' ) , h a s b e e n a s s a i l e d i n t h i s a p p e a l u n d e r s e c t i o n  378 (4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure ( for short 'Cr.P.C.'). 
2. Having considered the rival contentions, it is noticed that the  sanction for prosecution under section 2 of the P.F.A. Act was flawed. It was found by the trial  c o u r t t h a t t h e s a n c t i o n s u f f e r e d f r o m n o n  application of mind inasmuch as the public analyst's report Exh. 112 revealed that the sample  of mixed fruit chutney was misbranded whereas the sanctioning authority vide sanction  order Exh. 125 proceeded on the premise that the food article was adulterated within  t h e m e a n i n g o f s e c t i o n 2 ( i a ) ( j ) o f t h e P . F . A . A c t . I t i s n o t i c e d f r o m t h e  r e c o r d t h a t t h e p u b l i c a n a l y s t ' s r e p o r t E x h .

sentences.text: 1 1 2 g i v e s n o f i n d i n g w i t h  r e g a r d t o t h e l i m i t o f t h e a d d i t i o n o f t h e p e r m i t t e d c o l o u r i n g m a t t e r i n a  f o o d a r t i c l e .

I t m e r e l y s t a t e d t h a t t h e s a m p l e o f m i x e d f r u i t c h u t n e y i s  m i s b r a n d e d w i t h i n t h e m e a n i n g o f p r o v i s o t o R u l e 2 9 o f t h e P . F . A R u l e s  a s a l s o t h e p r o v i s o t o s e c t i o n 2 ( i ) o f t h e P . F . A A c t . T h u s , w h e n t h e f o o d  article was not reported to be adulterated, the finding in the sanction order Exh. 125 that it  w a s a d u l t e r a t e d , d e f i n i t e l y s u f f e r e d f r o m n o n  a p p l i c a t i o n o f m i n d a n d t h u s t h e s a n c t i o n w a s n o t g i v e n i n a c c o r d a n c e
The court below was therefore justified in rendering acquittal for the above mentioned  respondents warranting no interference in acquittal appeal by this court.
The appeal  therefore fails and is dismissed.

(G.R.UDHWANI, J) niru*
